description: In this newscast: The popular Goldbelt Tram in downtown Juneau will remain closed as it undergoes repairs and inspections; More than 300 high school seniors are expected to graduate in Juneau this Sunday, Alaska Airlines might add a flight from Juneau to Portland, without stopping in Seattle; Douglas Island Pink and Chum celebrates its 50th anniversary this year; Hundreds of people gathered in Hoonah last weekend to unveil a new totem pole arch and honor wall dedicated to Hoonah veterans and their families

title: At least 90 dead in Chinese coal mine explosion, state media reports
description: The explosion took place at 19:29 local time on Friday at a coal mine in northern China.

title: Coal mine gas explosion in China kills 82 people, state media say
description: A gas explosion at a coal mine in China's northern province of Shanxi killed at least 82 people. Official news agency Xinhua said the accident happened on Friday evening and 247 workers were trapped.

title: SpaceX launches its biggest, most beefed-up Starship yet on a test flight
description: The mega rocket made its debut two days after SpaceX CEO Elon Musk announced he's taking the company public. NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman said Starship is now one step closer to the moon.

title: Trump administration to force foreigners in the U.S. to apply for a green card abroad
description: Foreigners in the U.S. who want a green card will need to leave and apply in their home country, the Trump administration announced Friday, in a surprise change to a longstanding policy.

title: Rubio arrives in India ahead of Quad talks as U.S. tries to reset strained ties
description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio arrived in India on Saturday ahead of a meeting next week with his counterparts from India, Australia, and Japan, members of the Indo-Pacific strategic alliance.

title: 'It Takes Two' rapper Rob Base, who helped bring hip-hop mainstream, dies at 59
description: Rapper Rob Base has died after a battle with cancer. He was 59. His team shared the news of his death on his Instagram page. Base was one half of the Harlem hip-hop duo Rob Base & DJ E-Z Rock.

title: Putin vows retaliation after accusing Ukraine of hitting student dormitory
description: Ukraine said it hit Russia's elite Rubicon drone military unit in a Moscow-occupied part of eastern Ukraine.

title: SpaceX launches massive Starship V3 rocket on test flight
description: The largest and most powerful rocket in history blasted off after its first attempted launch was postponed.

title: UK officials suggested single market for goods with Europe
description: Industry figures briefed on the move said the idea has not been taken forward at this point, after EU scepticism.

title: 1 person died, 36 injured after blast at New York City shipyard, officials say
description: One person has died after a blast Friday at a New York City shipyard, officials say. They said 36 people were injured, most of them firefighters and other first responders.
